about_the_game:
Saláta - A Card Game of Strategy, Luck, and Rivalry!

Welcome to Saláta, the ultimate card game where friends become frenemies and every move counts! Whether you're a seasoned card shark or a complete beginner, Saláta offers endless fun, chaos, and clever strategy for everyone.

Key Features

🃏 Familiarity with French Cards is a Plus, But We'll Teach You!
Not familiar with French playing cards? No worries! You'll pick up the basics in no time.

🤝 Make Enemies, Not Friends
The core of Saláta is all about messing with your opponents. Hand out negative points and watch alliances crumble as you fight for the top score.

🎲 Luck Meets Strategy
Combine tactical thinking with a bit of luck to outsmart your opponents. Every decision you make can shift the balance of the game.

🔄 Unique Game Modes Every Turn
Choose from 8 different game modes on your turn, but beware—once you pick one, you can’t select it again until your options reset! Your choices not only affect your current strategy but also your future moves.

👥 Play With Up to 4 Players
Battle it out with up to 4 players—or use bots if you're flying solo. We're working on expanding the game to support 5 or 6 players soon!

🤖 Bots That Play Fair
Play against bots who can’t see your cards, giving you a challenging but fair solo experience.

🌐 Quick Play or Cross-Platform Lobbies
Join quick-play lobbies to instantly jump into the action or host custom games with friends across platforms, including Android phones.

📱 Host It Anywhere
Host a game on your tablet and let up to 4 players join the fun locally for an awesome party experience.

🌍 Play in Your Language
Enjoy the game in your native language, and if it’s not available, reach out—we’re always adding more!

🎯 Complete Challenges
Test your skills with exciting in-game challenges that push your strategy to the next level.

📈 Cumulative Scoring
Track your success with cumulative scores that rate your overall performance across games.

🎨 Earn Customizable Card Backs
Unlock unique card backs to personalize your deck as you master the game.

💬 Join the Community
Share your incredible hands, epic scores, or just chat strategy on our Discord server.

Ready to Play?

Dive into Saláta, where every turn is a mix of risk, reward, and revenge. Whether you're playing solo or with friends, the fun (and the drama) never stops!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64 bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 3 1300X
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 460 (or newer)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 215 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: A 1080p display recommended

short_description: Dive Into Saláta: A fun, extremely cruel card game that blends luck and strategy with a touch of mischief. Hand out negative points, choose your moves carefully, and master 8 unique game types—all while making enemies out of friends!
supported_languages: English, German, Hungarian, French, Italian, Spanish - Spain, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Indonesian, Japanese, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Swedish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese, Korean
